summary: Maxeon Solar Technologies, Ltd. (Under Judicial Management) filed a Form 6-K disclosing that on June 18, 2026, letters of demand were delivered to certain subsidiaries accelerating the outstanding principal and accrued interest on its 1st Lien and 2nd Lien Convertible Senior Secured Notes due 2028/2029. The acceleration was triggered by events of default arising from voluntary judicial management applications, with the High Court of Singapore placing the company under interim judicial management on April 9, 2026, and full judicial management on May 29, 2026. The judicial managers are reviewing the demand letters and will release further announcements. This filing signals a formal creditor enforcement action against a company already in court-supervised restructuring in Singapore, equivalent to a U.S. Chapter 11 filing. Watch for potential asset sales or liquidation outcomes as the judicial management process unfolds.
